Remote (India). 60 days notice period.

Early-career data engineer focused on building reliable ETL and analytics pipelines using cloud data platforms.

Data Engineer, Nykaa — May 2025 - Present
Built and maintained nightly ETL pipelines that ingested product catalog, inventory, and order events into Snowflake; improved pipeline reliability by implementing DAGs and retries in Airflow. Developed Python-based data validation and transformation modules to standardize SKU attributes and reduce downstream join failures. Implemented incremental load patterns on Snowflake using merge strategies and time-partitioned tables, lowering query costs. Automated data quality alerts via AWS Lambda and CloudWatch for failed loads and schema drift. Collaborated with analytics and ML teams to provide clean feature-ready tables on Databricks for experimentation. Used Git for version control, documented processes and runbooks in Confluence, and managed job deployments on Linux-based Airflow workers.

Skills: Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, AWS, Databricks, Linux, Confluence, Git

Education: CA, ICAI
